nodes.title: TrackFX_GetParam returns 3 values, not 4
nodes.description: REAPER's TrackFX_GetParam returns (value, min, max) — 3 values. Destructuring as 4 (the original buggy code did `local _, _, mn, mx = ...`) silently sets min/max to nil. The bug hid in CUCO Random Walk's classifier from inception until 2026-05-07. Always destructure as `local _, mn, mx = ...`. Same trap exists in any code that calls TrackFX_GetParam.

nodes.title: TrackFX_GetNumParamSteps does not exist
nodes.description: There is no TrackFX_GetNumParamSteps in REAPER's API. To detect stepped params, sample 24 points across the range via TrackFX_FormatParamValue and count distinct formatted strings (≤16 distinct → stepped with that count). Live REAPER metadata via TrackFX_GetParameterStepSizes is authoritative for is_toggle/step_count when available.

nodes.title: ReaImGui diverges from upstream Dear ImGui
nodes.description: cfillion's ReaImGui binding does not match upstream Dear ImGui 1:1. Flags like AllowItemOverlap may be absent; Begin/End contracts have specific patterns; Viewport_GetWorkSize may not exist on older builds (wrap in pcall). Always query context7 /cfillion/reaimgui before writing or fixing any reaper.ImGui_* call.

nodes.title: Plugin library file is 57MB — never full-read
nodes.description: ~/Library/Application Support/REAPER/Scripts/CUCO Random Walk Plugin Library.lua is 57MB / 566K lines. grep/awk/sed with line ranges is fine; full Read tool calls are NOT. Use line-anchored greps like `^M\[` for plugin entries. Watch for non-UTF8 byte-sequence errors in awk from plugin names.

nodes.title: Migrate to CUCO-reaper monorepo (Lua + JSFX, dev-folder + symlinks)
nodes.description:
Migrate from REAPER's runtime folders into a single dev-folder git repo at `~/Work/Development/CUCO-reaper/`, then symlink REAPER's paths back so REAPER reads through the dev source.

Source today:
- `~/Library/Application Support/REAPER/Scripts/CUCO/` (already a git repo with this IG)
- `~/Library/Application Support/REAPER/Effects/CUCO_plugins/` (no git, just files)

Target:
```
~/Work/Development/CUCO-reaper/
├── .git/  CLAUDE.md  .planning/  .claude/  .issues.json  tools/
├── Scripts/CUCO/   (existing project content; symlink → REAPER/Scripts/CUCO)
├── Effects/        (JSFX moved here; symlink → REAPER/Effects/CUCO)
│   ├── lib/  Mixing/  Modulation/
└── Instruments/    (empty, future; symlink → REAPER/Effects/CUCO Instruments later)
```

Sequence:
1. Pre-flight commit any pre-existing uncommitted Lua-side mods so the move is a clean tree-shape change.
2. `mv "$REAPER_HOME/Scripts/CUCO" "$DEV/CUCO-reaper"` — preserves `.git/`.
3. Inside repo: create `Scripts/CUCO/`, `git mv` existing project content into it, leaving meta files (`CLAUDE.md`, `.planning/`, `.claude/`, `.issues.json`, `tools/`) at root.
4. `mv "$REAPER_HOME/Effects/CUCO_plugins"/* Effects/`. Reorganize into `lib/`, `Mixing/` (CUCO ReCenter family), `Modulation/` (CUCO Sweep).
5. Update JSFX imports in 2 files (CUCO Sweep, CUCO ReCenter v5): `import CUCO_plugins/lib/...` → `import CUCO/lib/...`.
6. Move docs from `Effects/CUCO_plugins/docs/` → `.planning/research/`. Delete the placeholder at `Effects/CUCO_plugins/docs/handover.md` (was a redirect; its canonical content is the handover at `.planning/handovers/`).
7. Symlinks: `ln -sfn "$DEV/CUCO-reaper/Scripts/CUCO" "$REAPER_HOME/Scripts/CUCO"`; same for `Effects/CUCO`.
8. Sanity-load both JSFX plugins from new symlinked location to confirm imports resolve.
9. One commit: `chore: restructure as CUCO-reaper monorepo (Lua + JSFX)`.

Layout is ReaPack-ready (Scripts/, Effects/ at root match REAPER's runtime tree) but ReaPack metadata is out of scope for this task — separate follow-up.

Full session context (what was built, audio-test plan, DSP gotchas, suite conventions) lives in the handover doc + the JSFX research docs that move in step 6.

notes.text: Migration landed at 8d279f6. New tree: Scripts/CUCO/ + Effects/ + tools/ at ~/Work/Development/CUCO-reaper, symlinked to REAPER's runtime paths. scripts/ → tools/ rename was an unforeseen step (case collision with Scripts/ on case-insensitive APFS); 10 files updated. JSFX: 5 unbucketed plugins (Additive, Spear, Multiband Correlation Meter, ABLevelMatching_Modified, JM_ana_Correlation) at Effects/ root pending future categorisation. Sanity-load of the two new JSFX (CUCO Sweep, CUCO ReCenter v5) from new symlinked location is the user's verification step (REAPER reload required).

nodes.title: ReaPack scaffolding: install reapack-index, .reapack-index.conf, repo metadata
nodes.description:
Set up the repo for ReaPack publication. Steps:

1. Install `reapack-index` Ruby gem (system-level, user runs).
2. Create `.reapack-index.conf` at repo root. Whitelist approach: only `Scripts/CUCO/projects/keyframe/CUCO Keyframe.lua` and `Scripts/CUCO/projects/random-walk/CUCO Random Walk GUI.lua` get indexed; everything else (`experiments/`, `archive/`, `utilities/`, `Effects/`, `CUCO Archival/`, `CUCO Import Session Track/`, `audiosuite-plus/`, `metadata-workflow/`, etc.) excluded via ignore patterns.
3. Decide repo-level metadata (catalog name, description, link to GitHub).

Fixed decisions: catalog name is 'CUCO - REAPER Scripts', shared category 'CUCO'.

Blocks T-019 and T-020 — script prep can only proceed once `.reapack-index.conf` knows what to scan.

notes.text: Done. Brew Ruby 4.0.3 installed (system Ruby 2.6 too old for rugged native build); reapack-index 1.2.6 at ~/.gem/ruby/4.0.0/bin/reapack-index; pandoc installed for @about RTF conversion. .reapack-index.conf at repo root whitelists 2 scripts via ignore-everything-else; --check confirms 2 packages, 0 failures. Catalog name 'CUCO - REAPER Scripts' lives in conf but only writes to index.xml on real run (T-021).

nodes.title: Keyframer ReaPack prep: dofile refactor, @provides, fix @version drift, @changelog
nodes.description:
Prepare CUCO Keyframer.lua for ReaPack distribution:

1. **Fix version drift**: header says `@version 0.6.0` but `local SCRIPT_VERSION = '0.7.0'`. Sync to 0.7.0 (or bump to 1.0.0 if this is the publication-ready cut).
2. **Refactor dofile resolution**: replace the `(.*/CUCO/)` regex anchor with a script-relative resolver (`debug.getinfo(1,'S').source:match('(.*[/\\])')` + `../_shared/cuco_imgui_theme.lua`). Survives ReaPack install where the package dir is NOT named CUCO.
3. **Add `@provides ../_shared/cuco_imgui_theme.lua`** so ReaPack bundles the theme module when a user installs Keyframer.
4. **Tighten `@changelog`**: add structured entries for 0.7.0 (envelope shape picker + shared theme) — required for ReaPack-generated per-version changelogs.
5. Verify Keyframer still loads under the dev symlink path (`~/Library/.../REAPER/Scripts/CUCO/...`) after the refactor.

notes.text: Closed at bf9e167. Rename + version drift fix + @provides + @changelog + script-relative dofile resolver. Verified: luac syntax OK, reapack-index --check 0 failures, REAPER reload + GUI render confirmed by user.

nodes.title: Random Walk ReaPack prep: dofile refactor, @provides, @license
nodes.description:
Prepare CUCO Random Walk GUI.lua for ReaPack distribution:

1. **Refactor dofile resolution** (same pattern as T-019): script-relative anchor instead of `(.*/CUCO/)`.
2. **Add `@provides ../_shared/cuco_imgui_theme.lua`** for theme bundling.
3. **Add `@license MIT`** (or chosen license) — currently absent.
4. Optional: `@dependencies ReaImGui` (a hint to users; the script already shows an install-prompt at startup if missing).
5. Verify Random Walk still loads under the dev symlink path after the refactor.

Likely closes T-002 (Random Walk plugin metadata coverage) and T-005 (Random Walk distribution polish) along the way — assess at landing.

nodes.title: Generate index.xml, commit, push to origin/main, verify ReaPack import
nodes.description:
Final publication:

1. Run `reapack-index` from repo root → produces `index.xml`.
2. Inspect `index.xml`: confirm only 2 `<reapack>` entries (Keyframer, Random Walk), no others.
3. Commit `index.xml` + any script changes from T-019/T-020.
4. **Push to origin/main** (currently 17+ commits ahead). USER-VISIBLE STEP — confirm before running.
5. Verify ReaPack URL resolves: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/curlcomplex/cuco/main/index.xml`.
6. Test in a fresh REAPER: ReaPack > Manage > Import → paste raw URL → both packages appear under category 'CUCO'.
7. Install each, exercise the GUI, confirm `_shared/cuco_imgui_theme.lua` got bundled and dofile resolution works post-install.

Fulfills both M-001 (Random Walk distribution) and M-004 (Keyframer distribution) on success.
